title: GoOrganicAfrica Equatorial Guinea calculator readiness review — Batch 18

sources.name: INEGE Statistical Yearbook of Equatorial Guinea 2026
sources.use: Official yearbook source inventory; data updated through December 2025; selected disaggregation by region/province/district.

sources.name: INEGE 2026 yearbook release
sources.use: Official release summary reports 2.5% cocoa production growth in 2024/2025.

sources.name: UK Permanent Committee on Geographical Names, Equatorial Guinea Toponymic Factfile
sources.use: Official 2026 toponymic factfile confirms two regions and eight first-order provinces.

sources.name: FAOSTAT Crops and livestock products
sources.use: Primary international dataset identified for crop-level extraction; raw country export still required.

administrative_geography.note: Do not mix districts into the province selector.

evidence_findings: INEGE's 2026 Statistical Yearbook was released on 25 September 2026 and contains data updated through December 2025.
The yearbook covers agriculture, prices and wages and states that selected indicators are disaggregated by region, province and district; numeric crop tables were not extracted in this batch.
INEGE reports cocoa production growth of 2.5% in 2024/2025. This is a growth rate only and must not be treated as an absolute production quantity, yield or farmgate price.
The official 2026 toponymic factfile confirms two regions and eight first-order provinces.

criteria.crop_area_production_yield_by_commodity_: partial — current official yearbook identified, numeric crop tables not extracted
criteria.dated_local_farmgate_prices_and_units: blocked — no validated dated farmgate series
criteria.labour_rates_and_operations: blocked — no validated farm-operation wage schedule
criteria.regional_enterprise_budget_and_gross_mar: blocked — no complete regional enterprise budgets
criteria.currency_and_exchange_rate_method: partial — XAF identified, calculator conversion/rounding method not validated
criteria.source_provenance_and_observation_date: partial — official source dates recorded; underlying crop observations still need extraction
criteria.calculator_mapping_and_test_cases: blocked — no validated data mapping or country test cases

blockers: Extract and validate crop-specific area, production and yield tables from the 2026 INEGE yearbook and raw FAOSTAT; record year, season, unit, geography and observation status.
Obtain dated local farmgate prices for priority crops; do not substitute consumer-market or wholesale prices.
Obtain farmer-facing seed, fertilizer, crop-protection, irrigation, labour, machinery and land-preparation quotations by relevant province.
Build and validate regional enterprise budgets and gross margins using documented local operations and costs.
Define the XAF currency and exchange-rate method, map validated values to the existing calculator schema, and add test cases.
safeguards: No activation of GQ calculator profile.
No changes to the 10 existing active country profiles or calculator formulas.
No invented crop yields, prices, input costs or enterprise budgets.
next_step: Extract the agriculture tables from the 2026 INEGE yearbook and the raw FAOSTAT export, then source dated farmgate prices and provincial input-cost evidence.
